scientific_integrity: The equatorial principal curvature is reconstructed by differentiating the stated quadratic obstacle equation. The coefficient and uniform error are proved from exact positive recurrences rather than fitted from numerics. Subsequent independent checking has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Planar trapped billiard-ball dynamics only; eventual large-beta domination; coefficients depend on the fixed Gibbs measure; no flow-time normalization, no sharpness or global continuation assertion.
title: Two-term large-flattening Lyapunov law for planar-trapped ellipsoidal billiards
